transcript.speaker: Liam Johnson
transcript.content: Ethan, I know you're cautious about new methods — I was the same way at first. This natural horsemanship stuff is all about better communication, not gimmicks, and I truly believe it makes horses more responsive and happier. How about a short, supervised 15–20 minute trial today; you watch and feel it out, and if it doesn't sit right with you we go back to your routine — fair?

transcript.speaker: Ethan Johnson
transcript.content: Thanks, Dad — I appreciate you wanting to include me. I’m willing to be open, but I need a bit more reassurance: can you show me a short demonstration with one of your calmer horses first and tell me who’s taught you this method or share any testimonials? If it looks safe and the vet’s on board, I’ll watch the 15–20 minute supervised trial and we’ll go from there.
